meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 它会把电商商品信息写成图片营销文案:先收集产品名称、卖点、目标用户,再按「痛点—产品—卖点—情感」四段结构,产出带 emoji 的 Markdown 文案;也能优化已有文案。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或优化需求时触发,例如为智能家居、数码配件等类目商品写文案。

say.text: 帮我为这款便携充电宝写电商文案,卖点是快充和大容量
say.note: 它会先问产品信息,再产出 Markdown 文案。

say.text: 优化一下这条商品文案,标题不够吸睛
say.note: 它会重写标题、正文和 emoji。

say.text: 给智能睡眠眼罩写文案,目标用户是睡眠浅的上班族
say.note: 它会套用智能家居类模板写四段正文。

howto.what_en: It writes e-commerce image copy: it gathers name, selling points and target users, then outputs Markdown with an emoji title and a four-part body (pain point, product, selling points, emotion). It also optimizes your copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for e-commerce copy creation or optimization, for example writing copy for smart home or digital accessory products.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for this charger; key points: fast charge, capacity.
say_en.note: It asks for product info, then outputs Markdown copy.

say_en.text: Optimize this product copy; the title isn't catchy enough.
say_en.note: It rewrites the title, body and emoji.

say_en.text: Write copy for a smart sleep mask, aimed at light sleepers.
say_en.note: It uses the smart home template and writes four sections.
